rows: Idha bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṁvarasaṁvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū pubbarattāpararattaṁ jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto sātaccaṁ nepakkaṁ bodhipakkhikānaṁ dhammānaṁ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto.
